rulings.rule: NEVER re-merge or ship a big IA/visual rebuild of the opening screen to prod without Ashley previewing and explicitly approving it first (same class as the locked look).
rulings.applies_to: opening/home screen, any big IA reshape

rulings.rule: If HomeScreen is ever re-extracted/retired, the ten src/sections/* files and their tests must come back with it.
Comfort's 'Feeling Stronger?' graduation prompt is removed for good — never re-add.
comfortMode toolbar is Note+Close ONLY.

The arrival-open seed for congregation/deeper_study/pastor_leader/comfort must be persona-gated and CREDIT-FREE — it must bypass handleRead and never route through it (handleRead credits the plan day).
rulings.applies_to: congregation, deeper_study, pastor_leader, comfort — arrival seed

rulings.rule: A full-screen host surface that opens overlays (study sheet/note drawer/Bible AI) must use useSubView ALONE, not useSubView plus useModalA11y/aria-modal, or nested focus traps break keyboard/back-button navigation.
rulings.applies_to: any full-screen surface with overlays, e.g. Day N surface, BibleAI

rulings.rule: A conditionally-mounted card using useSubView(true,...) must stay MOUNTED with a live open prop, not be conditionally mounted, or it orphans a history entry per close and breaks Android back.
I'm New / new_to_faith path is exempt from the open-reading-on-arrival pattern — it uses the journey hero → full-screen Day N instead.
Sermon Notes row is demoted below the reading for congregation/deeper_study/pastor_leader/comfort; I'm New keeps it above only in the Sunday window (QR guests).
Ashley must see a deploy preview before merging; a PR can sit open awaiting his deploy-preview look and must not be merged without his word.
rulings.applies_to: new_to_faith simple-home change, generally any UI PR

rulings.rule: Choose-your-path is ONE sheet ('Where are you today?') with five cards, THREE doors to reach it (landing line under Read, path swatch pill on Home visible for every persona, an asked-once screen after first Mark as read) — never a gate that blocks first use.
The asked-once Door 3 screen is never shown for comfort or for users who already made a real choice; result is synced via dw_path_asked.
saveSetup must gate on source!=='default' — only REAL_CHOICE_SOURCES (onboarding/settings/upgrade) count as a real choice; auto-defaults never stamp as a real choice.
rulings.source: project_daily_word_choose_your_path, line 69; project_daily_word_platform_polish sync rules, line 118

rulings.rule: Tapping a card in the sheet must save AND open the screen immediately (commit(next)); no separate CTA below the fold — a bottom sheet must never put its only committing control under a scrolling list.
rulings.source: project_daily_word_choose_your_path, 'One tap opens the path' 2 Sep 2026, line 87

rulings.rule: Pastor lock is removed — a signed-in pastor can pick any path as a real choice; sheet shows a note plus 'Sign out of pastor account', no lock glyph.
Saving a path from the sheet must navigate to that screen (App navigates Home after a real change, not just close the sheet).
The sheet must fit a phone without scrolling — measured target ~481px tall at 390 width (537 with pastor sign-out row); typographic compaction only, no copy changes.
Use unused CSS class prefixes for new components — dw-path-* was already taken by the Plans-tab Superdesign chooser; the sheet uses dw-cp-* instead.
rulings.applies_to: CSS naming for new Daily Word components

rulings.rule: Reflect & Respond questions are written for every lesson day and are PART OF THE LESSON, positioned directly under the lesson text, before Mark Complete (not at the foot below the chapter).
Day 1 landing (cold-visitor) shows Day 1's questions under the pastoral text before Mark as read.

Any edit to /books/*.json content will be invisible to returning users unless the service worker cache strategy for that asset class is checked — /books/* must be network-first with cache as offline fallback only (fixed in PR #84); bump CACHE_NAME/STATIC_CACHE and SW_VERSION together for any sw.js change.
rulings.applies_to: any content/JSON change under /books or /bible, service worker

rulings.rule: applyCloudData must not overwrite journal (its jsonFields) — raw cloud data resurrects deleted entries; syncOnStartup's tombstone merge is authoritative.
applyMisc is FILL-ONLY — cloud must never clobber newer local content; writes to dw_user_story/dw_sermon_notes/dw_prayed_for call pushNow().
rulings.applies_to: misc synced fields, sermon notes, prayer list, user story

rulings.rule: Deletes are tombstones (deleted:true), never hard deletes, for journal and highlights.

Never rebuild a synced dw_* record from React state — merge into what is currently in localStorage and touch only your own fields, or a second device's cloud progress gets overwritten by stale mount-time state.
rulings.applies_to: any dw_* synced record, e.g. dw_pathway_progress

rulings.rule: Never reuse a bundled image filename for new content — overwriting hero-N.jpg serves stale cached bytes across browser and CDN; rename to fresh filenames and update the index.html preload link.
rulings.applies_to: hero images / any bundled asset swap

rulings.rule: Plan/reading day logic must use local date (toLocaleDateString('en-CA')) matching calcPlanDay's local midnight — never mix in UTC toISOString date logic.
pushSupported() only allowlists futuresdailyword.com/www/localhost — push cannot be verified on a deploy preview or the futures.church proxy, only localhost or prod.
A plan id is referenced in four places (personalization.ts, SetupPromptModal.tsx, PlansScreen.tsx, PastorStudyOnboarding.tsx) and all four must be rewired or the wizard starts a dead plan.
NLT translation is removed everywhere (no API key) — never reintroduce as a default.
Sermon frameworks limited to 4D and H.E.A.T. only (both defined on record); P.A.I.D., Five Fences, Five Batons are not defined anywhere and must never be invented.

Translated content (comfort devotions, questions, etc.) is CLAUDE-DRAFTED, ASHLEY APPROVES BEFORE SHIP — never auto-published without his sign-off, except where he has explicitly delegated (e.g. comfort translations he waived review on).

Catalogue: only rename '30-Day Faith Pathway' to 'Foundations of Faith' and merge the two comfort verse cards; weekly-review-for-all and a leaders featured row were explicitly REJECTED by Ashley — do not build them.

locked_look: Ashley's locked look for Daily Word is rich and editorial, never minimal or stripped: "bible app feel," "fresh clean inviting," then refined to "editorial and minimalistic, bright airy warm," with italics removed except for special purposes and any dark-mode override rejected; light is the default theme (deep terracotta clay #A8552F, ivory canvas #FAF6EF, ink text ramp), the hero reading panel stays white with dark upright scripture in both themes as deliberate "paper mode," and the DM Serif Text bundled font must not be reintroduced because it renders italic even at normal style — the correct serif is the Georgia stack (project_daily_word_platform_polish, 2026-06-25/26, lines 121-126; feedback_daily_word_today_rebuild_rejected, 1 Sep 2026, line 3).
preview_gate: Any big IA/visual reshape of the opening screen (or comparable owner-preview-gated change) must ship behind a deploy preview link that Ashley personally reviews and explicitly approves before it merges to main/production, never straight to main (feedback_daily_word_today_rebuild_rejected, 1 Sep 2026, line 11).
